learning_outcomes.text: Force analysis, dynamic motion analysis and balancing of machines are taught.

syllabus_topics: Force analysis of machines: Stability under the effects of static loads.
Force analysis of machines: Dynamic force analysis
Force analysis of machines: Dynamic force analysis
Dynamic motion analysis of machines: Introduction
Dynamic motion analysis of machines: Equivalent inertia, equivalent moment
Dynamic motion analysis of machines: Actuators; motor
Dynamic motion analysis of machines: Equation of motion
Dynamic motion analysis of machines: Flywheel selection
Balancing: Balancing in the machines having pistons
bibliography: Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, J.E.Shigley and J.J.Uicker, Jr. 1995 Mc-Graw Hill Comp., England.
